descriptionByLocale.en:
You can just trust everything you need? Then we entrust you with an asset management position! Together with more than 200 employees in nine departments, you manage the Helvetia Group's assets and third party customers and take care of the development and management of attractive investment solutions as well as the broad product range. Sounds exciting? Apply right away! Tasks: You hold the strings together
• You coordinate appointments, meetings, workshops and ensure smooth organization.
• You prepare meetings, accompany them and make sure that they are followed with meaningful protocols.
• You plan and organize internal events – from team events to larger events and retraits. You ensure transparency and knowledge transfer
• You manage internal communication channels and support the dissemination of relevant market and research information.
• You provide information in a comprehensible manner and make it accessible within the organization.
• You actively participate in the optimization of processes and the further development of our real estate organization. You work on projects with effect
• You support strategic and operational projects and take over tasks independently.
• You coordinate and develop regular reporting and reports.
• You take over versatile ad hoc tasks and bring your own ideas and solutions. Requirements: Professional profile
• Current Bachelor's or Master's degree programme
• First practical experience in real estate, project management or organisational functions is a plus.
• Safe handling of the usual MS Office applications, especially Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Personal strengths
• You work independently, think along and take responsibility.
• You also keep an overview of several parallel topics and set priorities skillfully.
• You are professional and deal with sensitive information with trust.
• You enjoy driving things forward, improving processes and actively shaping them. This is what awaits you
• A diverse field of responsibility with a high level of personal responsibility.
• Direct insights into the real estate management of a professional environment.
• The possibility of bringing in your own ideas and achieving visible effects.
• Cooperation with experienced professionals and decision makers.
• A flexible working environment that can be well reconciled with your studies. The Helvetia team is there together when it comes to it. We are people you can rely on. Those who support each other and work for each other, who demand and promote each other, who are enthusiastic and enthusiastic about each other. That's how we shape the future together. &Los!
